title: Every meeting ever 🗓️
description:
Every meeting ever. Bubbles slowly closes his laptop in the middle of a crowded video-call meeting and stares deadpan into the camera.

"This could have been an email." — Bubbles

Bubbles the Baby CEO: A baby. A boardroom. Zero patience for meetings.
Follow for a new episode every day.
